blendDesign:
The marketing skeleton stays proudly BRUTALIST; HiFi warmth is injected only at the two touchpoints that sell the "friendly live scorer" story — the conversion CTAs and the hero live-scorecard preview. Concretely:

HERO. Keep the giant 900-weight clamp() display H1 ("SCORE / ANY / GAME."), uppercase mono kicker, and the rotated decorative SportIcons. Add one HiFi plain-language prompt line under the subcopy that "asks the question" ("Pick a sport — start scoring in seconds."). Convert the two hero action buttons (START <SPORT>, SIGN IN) and the CTA-section buttons from boxy 8px hard-shadow buttons to 99px CAPSULE pills. The PRIMARY pill (START) gets a green-glow colored shadow (`0 12px 22px -12px rgba(18,147,106,.7)`) instead of the hard offset — this is the single friendliest, most-clicked element and reads as "actionable/live". SIGN IN stays a hairline-outline pill (no glow). Keep the existing sport-word roll animation.

HERO LIVE-PREVIEW CARD. This mockup literally advertises the upgraded scorer, so render it in the HiFi live idiom: soft-rounded 14–16px card with a warm-green-black SOFT shadow (`0 1px 3px rgba(20,40,30,.08)`) replacing the current `4px 4px 0 accent` hard offset; bump the score numerals up (mobile ~2.5rem→bigger, desktop 3rem→~4rem "friendly/celebratory"); swap the static "● LIVE" for a breathing opacity/glow pulse (1.4s); add ONE coaching caption chip under the score ("set point soon", "Need 73 off 44") pulled per-sport, previewing the HiFi coaching-caption feature; add a muted plain-language line ("Tap a side to score"). The sport-switcher tabs above it become small capsule PILLS (99px) instead of square bottom-border tabs.

SPORT GRID (14 tiles). Keep the boxy dashed-border cards WITH blueprint corner crosses (pure brutalist), but seat each SportIcon inside a 50% CIRCULAR green-tint medallion (`action-soft` wash) — a circular friendly tap-target inside a hard boxy card = best-of-both. Hover keeps the hard 4px offset + accent border.

EVERYTHING ELSE STAYS BRUTALIST: numbered section labels (01/APP EXPERIENCE … 04/HOW IT WORKS), 900-weight section H2s, hard 3px offset shadows + boxy 4px radius on Feature / Step / Experience-stat cards, black hairlines, off-white faint-green canvas, the mono ticker, watermark SportIcons, and the "READY?" close. Green stays reserved for emphasis; the glow appears on the ONE primary CTA only to avoid green overload. Optional restrained gold flourish on one trust note ("trusted by…") to seed the HiFi win/MVP palette.

blendDesign: Keep the screen's brutalist spine intact and graft ONE new HiFi surface on top: a "Live now" feed. Structure top-to-bottom: (1) brutalist typographic header unchanged — uppercase mono micro-labels, 900-weight clamp welcome numeral, 2px pure-black rule; (2) stat line unchanged, but add one gold-accent chip when a win streak/milestone exists (HiFi gold for achievement); (3) NEW "00 / Live now" section — the HiFi Home's defining feed. It lists the user's own active sessions PLUS (feature-flagged) friends' live matches. Each live card sits on a soft green-tint wash surface (not the stark dark card), carries a breathing LIVE pulse dot (opacity/glow 1.4s, not harsh blink), a contextual coaching caption chip ("2 sets all", "match point", "set point soon") as a green-tint pill, 50% circular participant avatar chips, and a capsule (99px) "Resume ›" / "Watch ›" CTA with a green-glow colored shadow. A small share/QR affordance sits top-right of each live card (Share-live entry). When no live matches: a designed empty row ("No live matches — start one below"). (4) Hero scorecard (no-active state) KEEPS the hard 4px offset shadow + CardCross corner marks — pure brutalism, untouched. (5) "01 / Sports", "02 / Recent", "03 / Tournaments" stay as naked typographic border-on-press rows — DO NOT roundify these; they are the identity. (6) NEW Activity teaser: a 2-line social-activity preview above the sports block linking to /activity ("Riya won vs Arjun · 2h", "Team Hawks is live"), rendered as brutalist rows with a mono "Activity →" affordance. Net effect: brutalist canvas with a single warm, rounded, breathing live-social band inserted where the HiFi Home puts its feed. The two shadow languages are assigned intentionally — hard-offset zero-blur black on static/brutalist cards, green-glow strictly on live/actionable CTAs — so the contrast reads as a system, not a clash.

risks: "Biggest risk: the Live-now + Activity feed depend on a social/spectator backend that does not exist yet — shipping the band without data leaves a hollow section. Mitigate by rendering self-owned active sessions as 'Live now' immediately (data already available via getActiveSessions()) and feature-flagging the friends'-live + Activity rows behind a designed empty/first-run state, so the Dashboard is complete standalone and lights up when social ships. Second risk: over-roundifying erodes the brutalist identity — strictly confine circular/capsule/green-glow to the live-social band and keep sports/recent/tournament/hero brutalist. issues: Identity: PRESERVED and disciplined. The design confines round/green-wash/capsule/green-glow strictly to the new live band and explicitly keeps sports/recent/tournaments/hero as naked hairline-brutalist rows with the 4px zero-blur offset + CardCross marks. The two-shadow-language split (hard-offset=static, green-glow=actionable) is a deliberate system, not generic softening. This is the strongest part of the design.

Real UX win exists but is narrow: only the SELF active-session restyle (breathing pulse replacing the static LIVE badge on the existing dark card, capsule Resume CTA, gold milestone chip) is a genuine, data-backed improvement. getActiveSessions() already supplies this data. Everything else is speculative.

SCOPE — too big as written. It bundles surfaces whose backends do not exist on main: no /spectator route (Watch has nowhere to go), no /activity route or friends/social layer (ActivityTeaser + friends'-live are dead links / fabricated rows), no Share-QR bottom-sheet component. Feature-flagging these does not make them shippable — it ships hollow UI and hardcoded sample copy ('Riya won vs Arjun').

Coaching-caption chip is not a Dashboard-local change. Session objects carry no derived status string; 'match point'/'set point soon'/'2 sets all' require a shared per-sport selector across the scoring engines (which the design itself lists as an unbuilt dependency). Including the chip in THIS card forces either that cross-cutting selector into scope, or a fabricated string that drifts from the live scorer. Cut it from PR-1.

NO ActivityTeaser, NO friends-live, NO Watch, NO Share, NO coaching chip. PR-2 (dependent follow-up, after /activity+/spectator+social land) = ActivityTeaser, friends'-live merge in liveFeed.js, Watch routing, Share-QR, coaching selector.

blendDesign:
CONTEXT CORRECTION: This screen is not the "Continue with Google/Apple/phone" auth screen — that is MonoLogin.jsx (Clerk <SignIn> inside MonoAuthPageFrame). /onboarding is the profile-setup wizard that runs AFTER auth and hands off to Home. Its HiFi analogue is the tail of "Onboarding · first run → Home" (the welcome + setup, then land on empty Home).

BIGGEST FINDING = design debt: the current file is NOT brutalist at all. It hardcodes off-brand blue (#0066ff) for the progress bar / selected chips / focus, plus generic greys (#eee, #ccc, #888, #fafafa) and 1px #eee borders. Everywhere else in the app the identity is #000 ink + hard 3px 3px 0px offset shadow + --se-color-line hairlines + --radius 4px + JetBrains Mono uppercase micro-labels. So the blend's first job is to bring this screen back into the brutalist token system; its second job is to warm it with HiFi. Two wins in one pass.

THE BLEND, step by step:

1) Shell + branding. Keep the tiny mono SCORE/EASY wordmark and SportIcon lock-up (already brutalist). Swap canvas #fafafa → --se-color-canvas (#F1F4EF faint-green). Keep max-w-sm, keep the mono-transition/mono-visible fade and the slide animation (harmless, already there).

2) StepIndicator → brutalist "chapter ticks" with a breathing current step. Replace the 2px blue fill bar with a hard-hairline track (1px --se-color-line) and a BLACK fill (--se-color-ink), zero blur, boxy. The current-step tick gets the shared gentle breathing pulse (opacity/glow 1.4s) — HiFi "you are here" warmth instead of a cold blue bar. Labels stay UPPERCASE mono micro-labels with wide tracking (0.1em), 700 weight; done = black, current = black + pulse, pending = --se-color-ink-faint. This is the signature typographic move restored.

3) Plain-language prompts (already half-HiFi — keep + lean in). The H1s already ask a question ("What's your name?", "How do you play?", "What do you play?"). Re-typeset them in the brutalist scale (Inter bold, tighter tracking) with a mono micro-caption beneath. Keep the friendly sub-copy. This is exactly the HiFi "the UI asks a question" trait, so preserve it verbatim and just re-skin.

4) Inputs (Name, Gamertag) → mono-input. Replace the inline-styled inputs with the existing .mono-input class: #000 border hairline, --radius 4px, mono @ prefix, hard focus shadow (--shadow-xs). The username availability indicator stays but recolors to tokens: taken/error = --se-color-danger, checking = ink-faint, Available = a small green ✓ using the LEAD green (the one legitimate decorative-green moment, and only a check glyph, not a fill).

5) Preferences — Role becomes CIRCULAR friendly targets (the core HiFi injection). Replace the 3 square blue role cards with three 50%-circle tap targets in a row (SportIcon-style glyph centered, label below in mono micro-caps). Unselected = white circle + 1px black hairline. Chip derivation is undersold: 'SET POINT'/'MATCH POINT' require look-ahead over games + deuce/advantage + tiebreak + sets-to-win. Labelling it 'derived from existing rule state' hides a non-trivial, must-be-tested helper that is the real work of this feature.

blendDesign:
The screen already has two internal layouts and each blends differently.

MODE A — TAP-HALF (football/hockey/handball/futsal, no quickButtons): the open borderless typographic tap-half (`.mono-arena-half`, big `clamp(3rem,min(22vh,26vw),8rem)` numeral, 2px accent baseline for the leader, accent-tint press flash) STAYS pure brutalist — this is the signature move and it already reads as HiFi's "tap a big soft target". The blend here is copy + context, not shape:
1) Promote the per-half "Tap +1" micro-hint into a single centered plain-language PROMPT in the `.mono-arena-seam` between the halves — "Tap a side to score" (football/futsal/handball) / "Tap a team to add a goal" (hockey) — styled as the existing uppercase-mono `.mono-arena-hint` caption (brutalist micro-label, HiFi micro-copy). The UI asks a question.
2) Coaching caption CHIP under the prompt driven by existing `goalsScoring` state: football clock → "FULL TIME SOON" (<5 min), overtime → "OT 1", basketball bonus/quarter → "Q3 · BONUS". New `.mono-caption-chip` = 99px capsule, 1px black hairline, `3px 3px 0 0.5px` hard black shadow, uppercase mono; green ink only when positive (lead/bonus), warning-brown when tied.
3) Top-bar LIVE badge (`.mono-badge-live`) gains a small breathing dot (opacity/glow pulse 1.4s, `prefers-reduced-motion` off) replacing the static state — gentle "this is live" instead of harsh.

MODE B — QUICK-BUTTON (basketball +1/+2/+3, rugby 3/5/7, kabaddi): the half becomes a read-only `role=img` display (keeps big numeral + overline). The stacked square `.mono-arena-action` buttons BELOW are where circular/friendly lands: replace the vertical stack with a horizontal row of CAPSULE/CIRCULAR point tokens (new `.mono-arena-chip`) — 99px pill (or 56px 50% circle when single-glyph like "+2") that KEEPS the brutalist skin: `#000` ink label, 1.5px black hairline border, `3px 3px 0 0.5px` zero-blur offset shadow, press = translateY(1px) + accent-tint flash. POST-GOAL ATTRIBUTION (football/hockey/handball/futsal): after a goal, a bottom-sheet asks "Who scored?" — reuse the existing `AppScoringConfirmDialog`/`app-confirm-*` shell (already a modal with Skip-equivalent + Confirm and the `isInteractionLocked` guard that pauses timer/scoring). Undo already exists in the control strip; surface the last event as a tappable "Undo last goal" chip near the seam.

CURRENT STATE (verified): Undo is implemented in all 5 engines but presented inconsistently. Cricket/Goals/Sets/Tennis render a text "Undo" via `.mono-btn` in the bottom `mono-scorer-control-strip` / `mono-quick-action-row`; MonoCricketTestLiveScore instead uses an icon-only `UndoIcon()` in `.mono-cricket-undo-line` beside OUT. Wording varies ("Undo" vs aria "Undo last action"); none use HiFi's "Undo last ball". No engine gives feedback on WHAT was reverted, and there is no edit/correction affordance beyond a single pop. Undo logic itself (history snapshot stack, freeHit/pendingExtra special-case at Cricket L483-499, keyboard 'U') already exists and must be preserved.

BLEND: Standardize a single shared undo control across all 5 engines that keeps the brutalist chassis and adopts HiFi language + feedback.

KEEPS BRUTALIST: control sits in the same 1px hard-black hairline `mono-scorer-control-strip` footer; UPPERCASE JetBrains-Mono micro-label with wide tracking; boxy strip layout; pure-black ink for the icon glyph and disabled hairline; press-flash uses `--accent` (existing `.mono-arena-half:active` idiom); any raised confirmation uses the hard `3px 3px 0 0.5px` offset shadow, NOT a blurred one, on its outer frame.

ADOPTS HiFi: (1) Uniform plain-language label "Undo last ball" — sport-aware noun via one map: ball (cricket), point (tennis/sets/volleyball/badminton), goal (goals). (2) Capsule/pill undo control (99px radius, reusing the existing `.mono-scorer-note` pill geometry) replacing the two divergent treatments. (3) A confirmation snackbar after each undo — "Reverted +6 · Team A" — reusing/extending `.mono-scorer-note` (already a fixed pill with soft shadow), with a warm-green-black `rgba(20,40,30,.25)` shadow instead of pure black, holding ~2.5s. (4) Optional "Tap to redo" chip inside that snackbar (stretch — see risks). (5) A quiet secondary "Edit ›" using the existing-but-unused `.mono-correct` class to reveal recent-action correction (hooks into attribution sheet when available).

The shared control calls each engine's existing `undo()` (never reimplements it) so freeHit/pendingExtra/keyboard paths stay intact.

blendDesign:
GREENFIELD read-only spectator match screen. A brutalist frame that hosts genuinely new data-viz, softened only at the navigation and data-point level.

STRUCTURE: `MonoSpectatorMatch` container = brutalist score header (big `mono-arena-num` mono numerals, one hard `3px 3px 0` offset-shadow card, black hairline seam between the two team columns, `mono-badge-live` LIVE) + a segmented sub-tab switcher for LIVE / MOMENTUM / POINTS / BOX. The four panels render below on the off-white `#F1F4EF` canvas.

MOMENTUM (the marquee new thing): an SVG "worm" of cumulative lead-margin over points/sets. Worm = crisp 1.5px BLACK stroke, zero blur, no gradient. Gridlines = 1px black hairlines; axis ticks = UPPERCASE mono micro-labels (0.1em tracking). The area UNDER the worm on the side that is ahead fills with the green-tint wash (`--se-color-action-soft` / #e7f4ee) — this honors the brutalist "green ONLY for lead/emphasis" rule AND lands HiFi green warmth simultaneously. Key-event dots on the worm are 50% circles; milestone dots (set point, 25-up, MVP moment) use the gold `--se-color-warning` token. A plain-language coaching caption chip sits above ("Hawks pulled away in set 2") reusing `.mono-cricket-chip`.

POINTS (point-by-point): extend the existing `mono-over-strip`/`mono-over-pip` ball-strip pattern into a per-rally timeline — boxy hard-bordered pips keep brutalism; tapping a pip opens a HiFi bottom-sheet with read-only who/how attribution.

BOX SCORE: reuse `mono-table-panel` + `mono-data-table` verbatim (already brutalist hairline tables); top performer row highlighted with the gold token, not decoration-green.

The one deliberately soft, circular HiFi injection = the sub-tab switcher (99px capsule segmented control), the round momentum data-dots + circular team-color legend swatches, a circular live-viewer-count avatar stack, and a round Share/QR FAB carrying the HiFi green-glow colored shadow (contrasted against the header's hard black shadow). Breathing LIVE pulse (opacity 1→.5, 1.4s) replaces any blink. Designed empty state ("Momentum appears after the first point") via existing `EmptyState`.

issues: BLOCKING data gap, verified worse than stated: completed matches wipe draftState (storage.js:152, MonoSetsLiveScore.jsx:349), so ZERO per-point data persists for finished matches. Live matches keep only a snapshot undo stack capped at slice(-50) (MonoSetsLiveScore.jsx:306/352) with no who/how attribution. MomentumChart, PointByPointStrip, and the attribution bottom-sheet have nothing to render until a NEW persisted semantic event log lands. That data-model change is its own PR and must ship first.

Over-scope / must split: the spec bundles 4 independently-shippable concerns its own 'dependencies' list flags as prerequisites. Split into a stack — PR1: persisted per-rally event log (scoring engine + storage); PR2: /watch/:matchId spectator route + public read-only-on-load match source; PR3: the 3 viz components + mono.css additions (MomentumChart, PointByPointStrip, BoxScoreTable, .mono-seg, .mono-chart-*, LIVE pulse, .mono-share-fab); PR4 (optional/deferred): live 'X watching' viewer count + real-time refresh. As one PR this is XL, not L.

Live 'X watching' viewer count needs real-time infra the app lacks: it is local-storage-first and useMatchSync.js has no spectator/subscribe path. The spec softens the first cut to read-only-on-load + manual refresh, which is right — but the viewer count should be cut from the first cut entirely (deferred to PR4), not merely softened, since it cannot be satisfied read-only-on-load.

Shared chart primitive coupling: MomentumChart must be co-built in a shared location and reused by the existing 'Match graphs (from history)' screen, or the two will fork. The spec notes this but it is a real build-order constraint — build the chart primitive shared, not inside the spectator folder.

Circular-injection budget is the largest soft-element cluster in the app (99px capsule tabs + round FAB with green-glow shadow + avatar stack + rounded sheet). As written it stays disciplined (confined to nav/data-dot/FAB), but this is the one place the blend can tip toward generic-friendly if the circular set expands during build — keep it exactly as scoped.
Effort is labeled L but with the blocking event-log data model plus spectator/read-only infra it is realistically XL across 3-4 PRs; L is only defensible for the viz-components PR (PR3) in isolation.

A single-team profile page that opens when you tap a team in TeamStatsTable (MonoStatistics.jsx:773), the players leaderboard, or a match detail. Structure top-to-bottom:

1) IDENTITY HEADER (blend): a circular team crest/monogram — a 50% circle carrying the team's initial, drawn the brutalist way (1.5px pure-black hairline ring + hard 3px/3px/0-blur offset shadow, no gradient). Beside it the team name in Inter 700, and an UPPERCASE mono micro-label ('SPORT · N TOURNAMENTS' at 0.1em tracking). This is the only place circular geometry enters the header, and it stays brutal via ink+hairline+hard-shadow.

2) HERO STAT (blend): the headline number — Win% — rendered as a big score numeral via the existing clamp(3rem,min(22vh,26vw),8rem) treatment, flanked by the W–L–D record in mono. A friendly plain-language caption sits under it ('Won 12 of 18 · unbeaten in last 5') — the HiFi 'UI asks/tells in words' trait, but typeset in the brutal mono micro-label. Optional brutalist win% ring: a hard 1.5px black stroke arc (a 'brutalist dial'), never a soft gradient donut.

3) FORM GUIDE (circular/friendly): a horizontal row of ~24px W/L/D dots — the HiFi form-pill idea — but each dot is a black-hairline circle; W fills with the reserved lead-green wash (#e7f4ee-equivalent via --se-color-action-soft), L with danger-soft, D neutral. Small, glanceable, celebratory without decoration.

4) MILESTONE / COACHING CHIPS (blend): 99px capsule chips ('Biggest win +14', 'Longest streak: 6', 'Best vs Wolves') — HiFi's contextual caption chips — but each capsule keeps a 1px black hairline + hard offset shadow. Milestone/trophy chips use the gold/amber accent (#b8862e) strictly for achievements; everything else stays ink.

5) STAT GRID (keeps brutalist): reuse InsightCard/StatCard (mono-stat-strip / mono-stat-number-card) verbatim for Points for/against, Avg margin, Closest match, Head-to-head record — boxy 4px cards, mono numerals, uppercase labels.

6) HEAD-TO-HEAD + MATCH LOG (keeps brutalist): the existing mono-data-table / mono-table-scroll for opponent-by-opponent rows and a recent-results log — thin hairline rows, mono columns, green=win / danger=loss on the result cell.

7) MOMENTUM STRIP (blend, restrained): a simple CSS bar strip of net-margin per match (spectator match-graphs idea) drawn as brutal hairline bars, green above the zero line, ink/danger below — NOT a charting library.

8) LIVE affordance (blend): if the team is in a live match, a gentle breathing-pulse 'LIVE now — Watch' capsule (1.4s opacity pulse) linking to spectator view, instead of a harsh blink.

Sub-navigation (Overview / Rivals / Log) uses the existing mono-tabs styling. Empty/first-run reuses the EmptyState component. Bottom tab nav stays consistent with the rest of the app. Canvas stays the off-white faint-green #F1F4EF; green stays reserved for wins/leads, gold only for milestones.

blendDesign:
A read-only momentum screen that reuses the MonoStatistics/MonoHistory page skeleton and renders the score progression as a hand-rolled inline-SVG "worm"/area chart drawn in the brutalist idiom, wrapped in HiFi coaching copy and rounded selectors.

LAYOUT (top to bottom): breadcrumb (BackArrow -> History) + `.mono-page-header` H1 "Momentum" with team-vs-team subhead; a headline mono numeral (final score / biggest lead) via clamp; a capsule set-selector pill row; the SVG momentum chart in a hard-shadowed card; a row of plain-language caption chips; a rounded "share of lead" momentum meter; designed empty state when no point log exists.

THE CHART (MomentumChart component, inline SVG, zero chart deps): x-axis = point index (or set-cumulative fallback), y-axis = score differential (lead). Axis lines are 1.5px hard black hairlines (`--se-color-line`), tick labels are UPPERCASE JetBrains Mono micro-labels at 0.08-0.12em tracking. The two teams render as 2px hard strokes with flat (no-gradient) area fills; GREEN (`--se-color-action`) is used strictly for whichever team is currently leading (the shaded lead region above the zero line), opponent side rendered in ink-black — green stays semantic (lead/emphasis), never decoration. Card frame keeps `--shadow-xs` (3px 3px 0 black, zero blur) and 8px card radius. Lead-change crossovers are marked with small 50% circular dots; on a live match the latest dot gets a gentle opacity/glow breathing pulse (~1.4s) instead of a harsh blink.

DATA: a new `buildMomentumSeries(match)` util derives `[{t, score1, score2, lead, servingTeam}]` from `draftState.history` (rich point-by-point, available for live/in-progress) and falls back to coarse per-set cumulative from `match.sets` for completed matches until the point log is persisted at completion (see dependency). It also computes biggest lead, longest run, lead-share %, and turning point for the chips/meter.

DATA FIDELITY understated: persisted draftState.history is structuredClone(history.slice(-50)) (MonoSetsLiveScore L306/L352), not the 'last 100' the risks section cites. The 100 is only the in-memory undo stack; anything LOADED from storage (including a live match opened in the graphs route) is capped at 50 snapshots. So even the 'live/in-progress rich point-by-point' path is 50-point-limited, and long matches lose early points more aggressively than stated.

HISTORY SNAPSHOT SHAPE: snapshots are {timestamp, sets, currentSet, servingTeam, scoringMode} (full sets array), NOT flat scores. buildMomentumSeries must flatten sets state per snapshot into score1/score2 — feasible but a real derivation step the design's clean [{t,score1,score2,lead}] shape glosses over. blendDesign:
This is a SETUP/config wizard, not live gameplay — so brutalism DOMINATES and HiFi is adopted mainly for guidance, celebration, and structural clarity. The 4-step wizard structure, all engine logic (cricket presets / sets / goals / knockout formats), squad/captain chips, and match-generation preview stay intact; this is a re-skin plus targeted HiFi affordances.

KEEP BRUTALIST: pure-black ink/hairlines/inputs; `mono-input` fields; `3px 3px 0 0.5px` hard offset shadow on selectable option buttons; boxy 4px radius on tournament-type buttons and rules controls; UPPERCASE mono micro-labels with wide tracking on every section header ("TOURNAMENT NAME", "TOURNAMENT TYPE", "BRACKET SIZE"); off-white #F1F4EF canvas; green reserved for the selected/active state (`mono-btn-primary`) only. The existing 24px step-indicator circles already read as brutalist-circular — keep them.

ADOPT HiFi UX: (1) Plain-language prompt sub-copy under each section header — the UI asks a question: "What are we calling this?", "How should teams face off?", "Who's playing?" — replacing today's bare labels-only feel. (2) Each tournament-type button gains a one-line plain-language descriptor baked into the option (not just the current single `tournamentTypeDescription` line) so the choice is self-explaining ("Everyone plays everyone", "Groups then playoffs", "Lose and you're out", "Best-of series"). (3) A friendly, GLANCEABLE bracket/schedule VISUAL on Review — a small tournament-tree (elimination) or round-grid (round-robin) rendered in brutalist hairlines, replacing the plain text schedule list, so users SEE the shape they built. (4) Celebratory Review step: the match-count becomes a big friendly mono numeral (60–74px clamp) — "12 MATCHES" — with a gold (`#b8862e`/`#e8b64c`) accent milestone chip; the "Start Tournament" CTA keeps hard black border + offset shadow but gains a green-glow colored shadow (`0 10px 20px -10px rgba(18,147,106,.6)`) and the geP breathing pulse to signal it's the actionable finish. (5) Designed empty/first-run state for step 1 when arriving with no wizard-prefilled teams: a friendly prompt + preset shortcuts ("Weekend league · 4 teams", "Straight knockout · 8"). (6) Gentle live/active pulse on the current step dot instead of a static fill.

Contextual coaching chips (HiFi caption-chip pattern) surface validation warmly: "Add 1 more team to unlock playoffs", "Even squads = fair draw" — reusing the existing warning logic but styled as soft caption chips rather than the raw amber/red boxes.

Below it a boxy hairline segment filter (All · Requests · Invites · Live · Milestones) built from 1px black-line tabs with --radius:4px corners and a hard 3px/3px/0 offset shadow on the active tab — NOT a rounded pill toggle.

The feed is grouped by time with mono uppercase section headers ("TODAY", "EARLIER") separated by .mono-divider hairlines. 8. NEW: reuse the shared bottom tab nav (Home · Play · History · More) so legal pages sit inside the app shell rather than floating — depends on that component existing (cross-cutting).
